pr_changes.title: fix: LogUniform NumPy log-prior returns -inf for value<=0 (emcee NaN crash)
pr_changes.api_changes:
Behaviour-only: `LogUniformPrior.log_prior_from_value(value)` now returns `-inf`
(was `NaN`/`+inf`) for `value <= 0` on the NumPy path. No signatures, symbols, or
defaults change; positive-value behaviour is identical. The only direct callers are
the `autofit_workspace_test` prior parity/regression gates
(`jax_assertions/priors_xp_dispatch.py`, `prior_correctness/emcee_gaussian_bias_check.py`),
which exercise only positive, in-bounds values and are unaffected.
See full details below.

pr_changes.title: docs: add signpost llms.txt + consolidate agent instructions into AGENTS.md
fix: skip latent computation without keys
pr_changes.api_changes:
`Analysis.compute_latent_samples(...)` now returns `None` immediately when the analysis has no enabled latent keys, matching the existing no-latent contract instead of attempting an empty latent batch.
See full details below.

pr_changes.title: refactor(latent): first-class Latent class + engine extraction (Phase 1)
pr_changes.api_changes:
No signature changes. New extension point `af.Latent` (declare `Analysis.Latent = ...`, override `keys`/`variables`). The legacy `Analysis.LATENT_KEYS` / `LATENT_BATCH_MODE` / `compute_latent_variables` still work — the default `Latent` delegates to them (back-compat shim).
See full details below.

pr_changes.title: Add optional arcsecond double-prime tick labels
pr_changes.api_changes:
Adds one optional config key, `visualize.general.ticks.symbol_over_decimal`, defaulting to `false`.
When enabled, 2D arcsecond tick labels use the double-prime symbol over the decimal point, e.g. `3.″8`; when disabled, labels remain unchanged, e.g. `3.8"`.
See full details below.

pr_changes.title: docs: add signpost llms.txt + consolidate agent instructions into AGENTS.md
feat: Preloads API for reusing channel-invariant inversion quantities
pr_changes.api_changes:
All additive and backward compatible — no removals or renames.

- Added `aa.AbstractPreloads` and `aa.PreloadsInterferometer(curvature_matrix=None)` — containers for preloaded inversion quantities (new `autoarray/preloads/` package).
- `AbstractInversion`, the interferometer inversions, and the `inversion_from` / `inversion_interferometer_from` factory gain an optional `preloads=None` argument.
- `InversionInterferometerSparse.curvature_matrix` now returns `preloads.curvature_matrix` directly when a preload is supplied (otherwise computes it as before).

See full details below.

pr_changes.title: fix: VectorYX2DIrregular from_dict round-trip (missing values property)
pr_changes.api_changes: Added a new public read-only `values` property on `VectorYX2DIrregular` returning the underlying `(N, 2)` ndarray. Purely additive — no existing call sites read `vec.values`. See full details below.

pr_changes.title: docs: add signpost llms.txt + consolidate agent instructions into AGENTS.md
Lensing potential for elliptical/spherical dark-matter profiles (NFW/gNFW) + NFWSph fix
pr_changes.api_changes: Adds a working `potential_2d_from` to the elliptical/spherical dark-matter profiles (via a single MGE-decomposition method on `gNFW`, inherited by `NFW`, `gNFWSph`, and all MCR/Virial variants). Corrects `NFWSph.potential_2d_from` (it returned values a factor of `r_s` too small). No public signatures removed or renamed; `MassProfile.potential_2d_from` now accepts `xp`/`**kwargs` (additive). Behaviour change: `NFWSph` potential values are now correct (≈ `r_s`× larger than before). See full details below.

pr_changes.title: fix(mass): convergence_func on PowerLawBroken, PowerLawMultipole, cNFW family
pr_changes.api_changes: Added `convergence_func` overrides on `PowerLawBroken`, `PowerLawBrokenSph` (inherited), `PowerLawMultipole`, and the `cNFW` family (`cNFWSph` + MCR variants inherit). `PowerLawBroken._convergence` is a new private radial helper. `PowerLawBroken.potential_2d_from` now raises `NotImplementedError` explicitly (it was already non-functional). No signatures of existing public methods changed. See full details below.

pr_changes.title: docs: add signpost llms.txt + consolidate agent instructions into AGENTS.md
feat: datacube shared-state for AnalysisInterferometer via curvature preloads
pr_changes.api_changes:
All additive and backward compatible — no removals or renames.

- `AnalysisInterferometer.__init__` gains an opt-in `shared_preloads=False` flag.
- New method `AnalysisInterferometer.shared_state_from(instance)` — returns a `PreloadsInterferometer` with the channel-invariant `curvature_matrix` (or `None` when not opted in / no inversion).
- `AnalysisInterferometer.log_likelihood_function` gains `shared=None`; `fit_from` gains `preloads=None`; `FitInterferometer` and `TracerToInversion` gain `preloads=None`, threaded into `inversion_from`.

See full details below.

Existing callers are unaffected. `LOSSampler.galaxies_from` now reads `autoconf.test_mode.is_test_mode()` internally; its signature is unchanged. No removals or renames. See full details below.
